title: CashFlowEvent
description: Version 1 of a dated cash-flow event.

label.description: Who it is with: a biller, a card statement, a client.

kind.description: bill = a stored bill, statement = a card statement paid from the bank, arrival = a client payment expected.

amountMinor.description: Signed integer minor units: negative goes out, positive comes in.

direction.description: in = money comes in, out = money goes out; follows the sign of amountMinor.

balanceAfterMinor.description: The running balance after this event, in the same currency. A pending bill is not counted.

estimated.description: true = the amount is an estimate (an amount-varies bill).

pending.description: true = a bill still waiting in To check; judged as if it were confirmed.

uncounted.description: true = the amount is not known and nothing can estimate it; the event counts as 0.
